name: Sonar Reasoning Pro
description: Search-augmented reasoning model combining web search with chain-of-thought.
longDescription: Sonar Reasoning Pro combines Perplexity's real-time web search with chain-of-thought reasoning. It can think through complex research questions step-by-step while accessing live web data, delivering deeply researched, well-cited answers.
limitations: Higher latency due to search + reasoning

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.perplexity.ai",
    api_key="YOUR_PERPLEXITY_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="sonar-reasoning-pro",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain quantum computing advances in 2025"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
